response.sql: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT order_reference, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM execution_counts) SELECT order_reference, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY share_minus_average_share DESC NULLS LAST, order_reference ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
